verdict.rationale: Published pricing is a fair question for LiveKit Agents, since the evidence shows it runs on LiveKit Cloud and LiveKit Inference. However, the pack contains no per-minute rates, usage tiers or cost-per-call figures. The only item sourced from livekit.io/pricing lists a feature (instant rollback), not prices. The community post about lacking cost-per-call visibility concerns runtime observability, not published pricing, so it neither supports nor disputes this story.
